text:
maria: Alert — we're seeing a sustained latency spike and request queueing in dedicated-gpu-pool-3 (us-west-2-prod). SLA alerts firing from several customers. GPU util ~96% and request queue depth growing quickly. Anyone oncall?

oncall-jamie: I'm on. Pulling dashboards now. Which signals are most elevated?

maria: p90 token latency up 3x. Kernel fallback events spiking in the runtime logs, and KV cache hit rate fell from 82% -> ~42% in the last 8m. Autoscaler didn't add nodes; looks like scale-up prevented.

infra-bot: autoscaler-event: scale-up blocked — quota_misconfig detected (reserved_slots_limit=0) on pool dedicated-gpu-pool-3. Ticket created: #INC-9876

raj: I pushed a batching heuristic change about 2h ago that biases towards larger batch formation to improve throughput. Could be increasing head-of-line waiting for smaller latency-critical requests. Rolling back the change now.

devon: I'm seeing long-tail in kernel selection decision path on the hot path — synchronous selection call is adding ~5-12ms per request under load. Profiling snippet (top stacks):

```
(pprof) top
14.2% runtime/kernel_selector.SelectBest
10.1% runtime/batching.WaitForBatch
7.4% runtime/kvcache.MissHandler
5.8% runtime/network.Dispatch
```

That kernel_selector spike looks new after last runtime tweak.

sre-elena: Two-pronged mitigation: 1) fix quota so autoscaler can provision nodes, 2) throttle noisy tenants and evict any large batch jobs that bypass priority. Can someone apply a quick quota patch?

maria: I'll apply a safe quota override to unblock scaling: setting reserved_slots_limit: 120 and enabling tenant_weight enforcement for burst limit. Patching now.

```
# applied via infra-config patch
pool: dedicated-gpu-pool-3
reserved_slots_limit: 120
tenant_weight_map:
  high-priority: 100
  default: 10
  best-effort: 1
```

infra-bot: config-update: reserved_slots_limit set -> 120 for dedicated-gpu-pool-3. Autoscaler re-evaluating.

deploy-bot: Reverting batching heuristic change in runtime v2.31 -> v2.30 (rollback).

raj: rollback completed, new binary rolled back to v2.30 on pool nodes.

maria: Autoscaler triggered node additions 3m after quota patch, new nodes joining. KV cache warming started; hitrate trending up.

devon: After rollback and quota fix, kernel_selector hotspots reduced — profile after mitigation:

```
(pprof) top
9.1% runtime/batching.WaitForBatch
6.2% runtime/kvcache.MissHandler
3.5% runtime/kernel_selector.SelectBest
```

Latency p90 back to ~1.1x baseline, p99 improving.

sre-elena: We'll evict the noisy tenant that was launching large best-effort batches during the window; also schedule a follow-up to make kernel selection async (non-blocking) and add a fast-path for small latency requests.

oncall-jamie: Created follow-ups: INFRA-2015 (quota validation on deploy), RUNTIME-1420 (async kernel selection), SRE-3099 (per-tenant burst protection).

maria: Customers notified via status page and support assigned to high-SLA tenants impacted.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback verified and promoted.

maria: Monitoring for 30m before closing. Thanks all. :pray:

raj: Notes for postmortem — batching heuristic change interacted poorly with kernel selection sync path and an edge quota config prevented autoscaler from responding. Root cause is 2 simultaneous regressions.

sre-elena: Agreed. We'll do a brief RCA doc and attach flame graphs + kvcache histogram. Ping me when you've gathered logs.

maria: Will collect logs and open postmortem. Marking incident as mitigated, leaving open for RCA artifacts.

(incident ends)
